title: Abductees tell Alberino of a forced hybrid breeding program
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Abductees tell Alberino of a forced hybrid breeding program, about ongoing at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: being abducted and they're being integrated into this breeding program forcibly.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that people who report being taken by non-human beings have told him they are being made part of a breeding programme against their will. In his telling, the aim is to produce beings that are part human and part something else. If true, it would mean people are being used, without consent, to make a new kind of being.
